sxablono.name: pagxo
sxablono.description: A page: its title — the one heading of level 1 and the focus target after a change of route — with badges beside it, a subtitle, the actions on the page and its sections.

regions.name: title
regions.description: The title of the page: a titolo of level 1, focusable — the one focus target of the page.

regions.name: badges
regions.description: Badges beside the title: the status of what the page shows.

regions.name: subtitle
regions.description: One line under the title that says what the page is about.

regions.name: actions
regions.description: The actions on the page; one primary at most, a destructive one in a menuo or as a butono of low emphasis.

regions.name: sections
regions.description: The sections of the page, each with a titolo of level 2.

goals.kialo: A page is one pattern, because its title is the one heading of level 1 and the focus target after a change of route, and its actions stand in one place with one primary at most.
